name: MonarchDeviceList
title: DeviceList
wrapsNative: MonarchCard with a androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column of rows (androidx.compose.material3.Text, MonarchBadge, android.text.format.DateUtils.getRelativeTimeSpanString, MonarchButton), androidx.compose.material3.AlertDialog to confirm, MonarchInlineNotice, MonarchLoadingState, MonarchEmptyState and MonarchErrorState
summary: The devices that have accessed an account: name, system, browser and location, when each was last used and first seen, This device and Blocked badges, and an optional Remove action behind a confirmation.
whenToUse: On an account's security screen, so people can see where they are signed in and sign out a device they do not recognise.
whenNotToUse: For apps that use the account, use MonarchConnectedAppsList. For security events such as a new sign-in, use MonarchSecurityAlertCard.
api: @Composable fun MonarchDeviceList(devices: List<MonarchDevice>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, title: String? = null, description: String? = null, state: MonarchDeviceListState = MonarchDeviceListState.Ready, retrying: Boolean = false, confirmRemoval: Boolean = true, now: Long? = null, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, onRemove: (suspend (String) -> Unit)? = null, deviceIcon: (@Composable (MonarchDeviceKind) -> Unit)? = null, rowActions: (@Composable RowScope.(MonarchDevice) -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchDeviceListLabels = MonarchDeviceListLabels())

class MonarchDevice(id: String, name: String, kind: MonarchDeviceKind = MonarchDeviceKind.Desktop, os: String? = null, browser: String? = null, location: String? = null, lastUsedMillis: Long? = null, firstSeenMillis: Long? = null, blocked: Boolean = false, current: Boolean = false)
enum class MonarchDeviceKind { Desktop, Mobile, Tablet, Unknown }
enum class MonarchDeviceListState { Ready, Loading, Failed }

class MonarchDeviceListLabels(listLabel: String? = null, unnamed: String? = null, current: String? = null, blocked: String? = null, lastUsed: String? = null, firstSeen: String? = null, remove: String? = null, removeLabel: ((String) -> String)? = null, confirmTitle: ((String) -> String)? = null, confirmMessage: String? = null, cancel: String? = null, removed: ((String) -> String)? = null, removeFailed: ((String) -> String)? = null, loading: String? = null, emptyTitle: String? = null, emptyMessage: String? = null, errorTitle: String? = null)

options.name: devices
options.description: The devices, shown in the order given.

options.name: description
options.description: Replaces the line under the title.

options.name: state
options.description: Ready, Loading or Failed. A ready, empty list shows the empty state.

options.name: retrying
options.description: Shows the retry button busy in the failed state.

options.name: confirmRemoval
options.description: Asks with an alert dialog before removing. Set false when onRemove opens the app's own confirmation.

options.name: now
options.description: The reference time for relative times, in epoch milliseconds. Without it they follow the clock, refreshed every minute.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Retries loading. Shows Try again in the failed state.

options.name: onRemove
options.description: Signs the device out and forgets it, given its id; remove it from devices when it returns. Shows Remove on every device except the current one; throwing shows the failure.

options.name: deviceIcon
options.description: An icon for each device's kind, hidden from TalkBack and tinted with the danger strong color when blocked. Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: rowActions
options.description: Extra controls after Remove in a row, such as a block or rename menu.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every other built-in string.

states.name: list
states.description: One row per device inside the card, separated by subtle dividers.

states.name: current
states.description: A success This device badge and no Remove button.

states.name: blocked
states.description: A danger Blocked badge and the device icon in the danger strong color.

states.name: removing
states.description: The row's Remove button shows its progress indicator; other Remove buttons are disabled.

states.name: remove failed
states.description: A danger MonarchInlineNotice under the header, "Couldn’t remove MacBook. Try again.", announced.

states.name: loading
states.description: Two skeleton rows from MonarchLoadingState, announced as "Loading devices".

states.name: failed
states.description: A small MonarchErrorState with Try again when onRetry is given.

appearance: A MonarchCard with the section header and rows separated by subtle dividers; names in the strong body style, the system line and the times in the caption style in the muted color, a success This device badge, a danger Blocked badge and small secondary Remove buttons. All are theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The parity map names LazyColumn rows; the rows are a plain Column inside a MonarchCard instead, because the list sits inside the app's own scrolling settings screen, where a LazyColumn without a fixed height cannot be measured (iOS makes the same choice). The web's renderActions is rowActions, a composable slot. The confirmation is the Material 3 AlertDialog with MonarchButtons, which closes when confirmed, so the pending state moves to the row's button and a failure appears as a notice in the card instead of inside the dialog, as on iOS. Monarch bundles no icons, so the device icon is a slot given the kind; the web draws its own. The web's headingLevel has no Android equivalent (the title is a heading) and its locale prop is the device's locale used by DateUtils. Times are epoch milliseconds.
accessibility: The title is a heading, from MonarchSectionHeader; the list is a traversal group named "Devices".

Each device is one element whose content description is its name and whose state is the badges, the system, browser and location and the times, built by a tested pure function; Blocked and This device are words, not only color or an icon.
The device icon is decorative and hidden.
The Remove button is a separate MonarchButton with a 48dp touch target, named "Remove MacBook".
The confirmation is a Material 3 alert dialog with a danger Remove and a ghost Cancel.
Removal and a failed removal are announced through a polite live region.
Badges and actions wrap onto further lines, so nothing is cut off at the largest font size.
edgeCases: A device with a blank name reads "Unknown device".
Missing system, browser or location parts are left out of the detail line; with none, there is no detail line.
The app removes the device from devices after onRemove returns; the list does not remove it itself.
Only one removal runs at a time.

examples.title: Remove a device
examples.setupTemplate:
var devices by remember {
    mutableStateOf(
        listOf(
            MonarchDevice(
                id = {{devices.0.id}},
                name = {{devices.0.name}},
                os = {{devices.0.os}},
                browser = {{devices.0.browser}},
                location = {{devices.0.location}},
                lastUsedMillis = {{devices.0.lastUsedAt|millis}},
                firstSeenMillis = {{devices.0.firstSeenAt|millis}},
                current = {{devices.0.current}},
            ),
            MonarchDevice(
                id = {{devices.1.id}},
                name = {{devices.1.name}},
                kind = MonarchDeviceKind.{{devices.1.kind|pascal}},
                os = {{devices.1.os}},
                browser = {{devices.1.browser}},
                lastUsedMillis = {{devices.1.lastUsedAt|millis}},
                firstSeenMillis = {{devices.1.firstSeenAt|millis}},
            ),
            MonarchDevice(
                id = {{devices.2.id}},
                name = {{devices.2.name}},
                kind = MonarchDeviceKind.{{devices.2.kind|pascal}},
                os = {{devices.2.os}},
                location = {{devices.2.location}},
                lastUsedMillis = {{devices.2.lastUsedAt|millis}},
                blocked = {{devices.2.blocked}},
            ),
        ),
    )
}
